verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI model/API platform, but the evidence shows no first-party DeepSeek CLI. The docs only describe using DeepSeek as a backend for third-party tools such as Claude Code or OpenCode, which are not DeepSeek's own CLI. The 'DeepSeek Harness' developer preview is aimed at agent harness developers and is never described as a command-line tool.
